title: Merge In Between Linked Lists
description:
You are given two singly linked lists `list1` and `list2`, along with two 0-indexed integers `a` and `b` satisfying `1 <= a <= b < length(list1) - 1`.

Remove `list1`'s nodes from index `a` to index `b` inclusive, and splice `list2` in their place. Return the head of the resulting linked list.
hints: Use two pointers separated by an offset of `b - a + 2`: when the slow pointer stops at index `a - 1`, the fast pointer sits at index `b + 1`.
Connect `prevA.next = list2`, walk to the tail of `list2`, and connect `tail2.next = afterB` in O(1) extra space.

examples.explanation: Nodes at indices 3 and 4 (values 3 and 4) are replaced by [1000000, 1000001, 1000002].
Nodes at indices 2 through 5 are replaced by [100, 101, 102, 103, 104].
